summary: Full-stack test of Weft rebuild. Backend relay: all 6 upstream GET endpoints (stats, strategies, traders, leaderboard, revenue, rewards) return 200 with real data. POST /relay/backtest with eth-long returns stats+equityCurve. POST /relay/ai/generate hit upstream daily anon cap (429 'drafted 5 strategies today without an account') — expected since the preview shares one upstream IP. Frontend: all 7 public pages render clean (/, /new, /strategies, /strategies/eth-long, /traders 104 rows, /leaderboard 23 rows, /revenue), no MakeMarkets/launchpad/$MARKETS remnants, nav is Weft/Strategies/Traders/Leaderboard/Revenue, suggestion chips fill textarea, ?thesis=… URL param auto-populates. Fixed one bug: served HTML had stale <title>MakeMarkets…</title> — a frontend restart cleared the webpack-dev-server cache and index.html now serves 'Weft · Trade the thesis.' correctly. Remaining issue: when upstream /ai/generate(/stream) returns the 429 rate-limit error, the UI silently resets the Draft button and shows no toast/message to the user.

minor.issue: SSE relay always returns HTTP 200 via StreamingResponse — upstream status code (e.g. 429) is dropped. When upstream returns a non-SSE JSON error body it is streamed as raw bytes but the frontend sseStream parser ignores it (no 'event:' / 'data:' lines).

Upstream enforces 5/day anon cap on this preview's IP → 429 with 'You’ve drafted 5 strategies today without an account.' Not a code bug but blocks live /new flow testing without auth. Consider surfacing this cleanly.

ui_bugs.issue: When the AI SSE endpoint responds with the upstream rate-limit JSON (non-SSE), sseStream yields nothing, the fallback weft.generate() also 429s, but no error toast was observed in the DOM; the Draft button quietly returns to idle. User gets zero feedback that nothing happened.

integration_issues.flow: Thesis → Draft the rules → Rules → Backtest on /new
integration_issues.issue: Could not verify the happy path end-to-end from the preview because upstream daily anon cap was already exhausted and the UI shows no indication. errorMessage(e2) toast did not render for this response.

action_items: Fix silent failure on /new when AI endpoint rate-limits: the SSE relay should either (a) relay the upstream 4xx status code when the response isn't event-stream, or (b) wrap non-SSE error payloads into an 'event: error\ndata: …' frame. Alternatively, parse the error body in New.jsx and show a toast/inline banner.

Add data-testid attributes to key /new elements (textarea, draft button, suggestion chips, rules card, backtest button, equity sparkline, stats cells) and public page cards/rows for stronger E2E coverage.
Delete stale meta description in /app/frontend/public/index.html (<meta name=description> still says 'MakeMarkets — market makers for every coin…').

Verify that the public preview's upstream daily anon cap can be reset or that the preview can authenticate against the upstream for E2E AI drafting tests (Privy is domain-locked to weft.fi per request).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py relay/{path}/stream: StreamingResponse hard-codes media_type='text/event-stream' and status 200 regardless of upstream — should propagate upstream status code (and content-type) when the response isn't actually SSE.
server.py: shared _http client is created lazily but never used for /stream (new client per request is fine); minor — connection pool reuse would help.
frontend/public/index.html meta description still references MakeMarkets (title was fine but needed a server restart to flush dev-server cache; main agent should verify this on next deploy).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_weft_relay.py (new pytest suite — replaces deleted old backend_test.py)
restarted frontend supervisor to flush stale index.html
test_credentials: none — all tested surfaces are public; /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not present (not required for this scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend relay suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_weft_relay.py (10 tests, all passing). test_relay_ai_generate accepts 200 OR 429 because upstream has a 5/day anon cap. All six public pages render cleanly; nav is 'Strategies | Traders | Leaderboard | Revenue'. The only unresolved functional issue is silent failure on /new when AI is rate-limited — reproduce by clicking 'Draft the rules' with any thesis after the daily cap is hit; SSE returns upstream JSON error body which the frontend doesn't surface. If upstream cap has reset, happy path should flow: textarea → draft → streaming progress → rules card (WHEN/WATCHES/DOES) → 'Run 30-day backtest' → equity sparkline + 8 stats.
